SlideMate 0.5 sets itself up: your university's slides and lecture recording, with no Terminal.

### New
- **Your university, built in.** Settings → **Your university** (also step 3 of the welcome screen): enter your
  Moodle or Blackboard address and press **Connect**. SlideMate installs the connection, opens your university's
  sign-in window, then pulls this year's slides into your library, one folder per course. After that, **Pull** fetches
  only what's new, and the tutor can check your deadlines and announcements.
- **Lecture recording sets itself up.** On Apple Silicon Macs, SlideMate downloads speech-to-text (Parakeet and its
  model, about 3 GB) in the background after setup. Settings → Lecture recording shows the progress. If you press
  Record before it's ready, SlideMate tells you, and keeps the audio to transcribe later.
- **Simpler connection settings.** Other MCP servers, importing from other AI apps and the Pull settings are still
  there, under **Advanced**.
- None of this needs Homebrew or Apple's Command Line Tools.

### Install
Already on 0.3 or 0.4? SlideMate offers this update by itself (or choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**).

New here: download **SlideMate-0.5.0-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. First open:
macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**; macOS 13–14: right-click → **Open**. The app isn't
notarised yet.
